name: Halftone
description: The picture breaks into printed halftone dots that follow its shades, the dots reshape into the second clip, then merge back into it. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: dots
params.description: Number of dots across the shorter side

params.name: angle
params.description: Angle of the dot grid, in degrees

params.name: paper
params.description: Color of the paper between the dots
